notes: The Tenderloin Times (1977 to 1994, 141 items), the Tenderloin's community monthly, every item in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers catalogued under that title. Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index; printed pages from _page_numbers.json. extra.candidate is the reader candidate number in the run's merge (scripts and the candidate file are in /mnt/project-files/mission-papers/, *tenderloin*). extra.number_as_printed keeps a street number the paper printed differently from the parcel's.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this title: every item the collection holds was read.
coverage.note: 141 items, 1977 to 1994; 9,118 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (ocr_mentions.py --rescue). The filter kept 1,049 windows, merged where they overlapped into 841 passages, read by five readers. 349 candidates; 186 set aside before entry: the rows of a July 1984 table of South of Market highrises (a survey, not events), heat and inspection roundups from the tenants' column, lists of buildings with no event, proposals with no decision, tenant disputes at unnamed buildings, proprietor-named shops, dining-guide anniversaries, campaign offices, repeats of one event across issues, and items whose street number the paper prints two ways (Argyle Hotel, Reality Arts, Lyric Hotel, Angkor Palace, Woolf House). 163 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text and its street number confirmed on the cited leaf; 145 resolved and 18 unresolved: 6 placed on a parcel and held (one thin fact on a parcel with no page; extra.placed_apn), 12 with no surviving address. 142 published on 119 pages (4 seeded), 3 declined because the page already carried the fact from a better source. Seeding 570 Ellis took up one held Building and Engineering News fact (v24-pt2-1924-jul-dec-1697, the 1924 garage permit), read against the page image.
